custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test, with Min 2, Max 6 and Sell Price $20.00.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839436-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839436-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Max reads 9.

Step 3:

  • The save goes through.

Step 4:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 5:

  • Sell Price reads $21.00.

Step 6:

  • The save goes through.

Step 7:

  • One entry reads "Min/Max updated | Max: 6 → 9 | Source: Edit Part", with no Min pair.
  • The Sell Price save added no second "Min/Max updated" entry: neither value changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | {changes} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History. {changes} is "Min: {old} → {new}" when only Min changed, "Max: {old} → {new}" when only Max changed, and both, Min first, joined by " | " when both changed. The source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10823, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Confirmed: A. Keep today's wording, showing only the pair that changed, e.g. "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 4 | Source: Edit Part". If both change, both pairs show. S10-R22a will be updated to match.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
